task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL. The function should take a URL like 's3://my-bucket.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/key' and return 'us-west-2'.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing read-only access to a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs, which follow the pattern 'i-' followed by 17 hexadecimal characters (e.g., 'i-0742d86d835822713').
